claims.assertion: Yazhi says White Hats are controlled opposition within the same Cabal, though individual insiders may help; she says true opponents would inform the public.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She frames terrestrial good-versus-evil and alien-war narratives as human projections in a self-contained Matrix, where friction may teach souls.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says experience and the soul are real, while each person decides what else counts as real.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

review_flags: Yazhi acknowledges some individuals may work in humanity’s favor but portrays White Hat organizations as part of the same structure.
